noteMain.text:
Home. A bento grid instead of stacked panels: drive cards carry their own banner and icon, a live backup card shows the current step (packing, uploading) with speed and time left, and quick actions sit one click away. Floating pill rail on the left.

Try: the theme and accent tweaks, pick a drive card.

Unbuilt: all of it.

noteDrive.text:
Drive workspace. A banner header for the drive, a pill command bar that folds into More, roomy file rows with type chips, and a details side sheet with versions and Open encrypted storage folder.

Try: select a file row.

Unbuilt: all of it.

noteBackup.text:
Docker Hub backup. One card per drive: state, last backup, part size (80 MiB) and the queue (Waiting for Studio to finish). The running backup shows packing then uploading with speed and time left.

Try: Back up now on a drive.

Unbuilt: all of it.

noteSettings.text:
Settings. Search with the regex builder beside it, grouped task cards, and real switches. Every setting stays reachable at 360 px.

Try: type in search, switch Regex.

Unbuilt: all of it.

notePhone.text:
Home at 390 px. Same content, one column: the rail becomes a bottom bar, drive cards stack, the backup card stays on top.

Try: tap a drive card.

Unbuilt: all of it.
